title: AI-powered vs. AI-built websites
cta: AI working inside your website, not just on the label

scenes.text: Is your website AI-powered, or was it just built with AI? They're not the same thing.
scenes.action: Looking at the camera with a curious smile, one eyebrow raised

scenes.text: Lately, a lot of people say their website is AI-powered because they used AI to make it.
scenes.action: Walking slowly toward the camera, relaxed hand gestures

scenes.text: But using AI to build something doesn't make it AI-powered.
scenes.action: Shaking her head gently, friendly smile

scenes.text: Think about it this way. If I use AI to make this video, the video isn't AI-powered. It just plays.
scenes.action: Pointing to herself, then opening her hands

scenes.text: A car built by robots in a factory isn't a self-driving car. It still needs you behind the wheel.
scenes.action: Sitting at a desk, hand gestures explaining

scenes.text: An AI-built website is the same. AI helped write the words or design the pages. Once it's live, it just sits there.
scenes.action: Pointing to a laptop screen on the desk

scenes.text: An AI-powered website keeps working for you after it's live.
It can answer your visitors' questions any time of day, even at two in the morning.
It can book appointments, take messages, and send them straight to you.
scenes.action: Tapping a phone screen, then looking up at the camera

scenes.text: It can follow up with new leads, so nobody slips through the cracks.
Built with AI means AI helped make it. Powered by AI means AI works inside it, every day.
scenes.action: Standing, one hand to each side as if comparing two things

scenes.text: So ask your web designer: what does the AI on my site actually do for my patients and clients?
scenes.action: Raising a finger, friendly but serious

scenes.text: At The WebSwan, we build websites and SBPA phone apps that work for you, with AI working inside, not just AI on the label.
scenes.action: Walking through a bright office, smiling

scenes.text: Want to see the difference on your own site? Call The WebSwan and let's talk.
scenes.action: Big smile, pointing at the camera
